name: HFCL Limited
remarksWeb: Vinsan Brothers Private Limited (Vinsan) and Shankar Sales Promotion Private Limited (Shankar) were the Promoters of the Company as on September 30, 2025. Vinsan and Shankar have merged with a member of our Promoter Group Entity namely Satellite Finance Private Limited, pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation dated July 8, 2024, which became effective on November 25, 2025. Accordingly, Vinsan and Shankar stand dissolved without winding up and are no longer in existence. The equity shares of the Company held by Vinsan and Shankar stand vested in Satellite Finance Private Limited by operation of law pursuant to the scheme of merger.   Further, pursuant to the aforesaid merger, 3,00,201 shares held by Shankar have been registered in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited and hence name of Shankar has been removed from the category of Promoter. Additionally, out of 6,71,600 shares held by Vinsan, 4,41,000 shares have also been registered in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited. As on December 31, 2025, a total of 7,41,201 shares have been registered in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited, and the balance 2,30,600 shares continue to remain registered in the name of Vinsan and are under process for registration in favour of Satellite Finance Private Limited.

name: HFCL Limited
remarksWeb: On June 28, 2024, NextWave Communications Private Limited (NCPL), one of the promoters of the Company sold 2 crore equity shares. However, since this sale transaction was not reflected in the Benpos data received from National Securities Depositary Limited (NSDL), the shareholding of NCPL as it appears in the Benpos received from NSDL, without accounting for the sale of the 2 crore shares, has been shown in the shareholding pattern as on June 30, 2024.

name: HFCL Limited
remarksWeb: The Company allotted 1,00,00,000 and 22,00,000 equity shares on 07.02.2024 and 22.03.2024 respectively pursuant to conversion of warrants. From the above, 1,00,00,000 equity shares were credited to the Companys temporary ISIN i.e. IN8548A01019, on 21.03.2024 by NSDL and were also put under lock-in on the same day. These shares are shown under Body Corporate category of the Promoters, although the same shares were credited  to the Companys permanent ISIN, INE548A01028, on 08.04.2024.  Further, the Company  applied for the listing of the balance 22,00,000 equity shares  on 30.03.2024, for which Listing Approval is awaited. These shares are yet to be credited and will be put under lock-in up to a period of six months from the date of latest trading approval to be received from  the Stock Exchanges. Further, out of 22,00,000 equity shares, 17,00,000 equity shares are  shown under KMP category and the balance 5,00,000 equity shares are shown under Resident Individual category of nominal value in excess of Rs.2 Lacs to take the effect of alloment. Out of the 1,41,00,000 warrants issued on October 15, 2023, 1,22,00,000 warrants have already been converted into an equal number of equity shares by March 31, 2024. Subsequently, the Allotment Committee (Warrants) of the Board of Directors of the Company, in its meeting held on April 11, 2024, also allotted 17,00,000 equity shares pursuant to the conversion of an additional 17,00,000 warrants, leaving a balance of 2,00,000 warrants. Further, the tenure of warrants shall not exceed 18 (eighteen) months from the date of allotment. If the entitlement against the warrants to apply for the equity shares of the Company is not exercised by the Warrant Holders within the aforementioned period of 18 (eighteen) months, the entitlement of the Warrant holder to apply for equity shares of the Company, along with the rights attached thereto, shall expire, and any amount paid by the Warrant Holders for such Warrants shall stand forfeited by the Company.  In view of the above terms of the issue of warrants, 2,00,000 warrants allotted to one of the warrant holders, who has sought early retirement from the Company, and since retired,  did not exercise the conversion option within 18 months from the date of the allotment, i.e. on or before April 14, 2024, stand forfeited, and  amount paid by him for such warrants also stand forfeited and as of the date, no warrant is pending for conversion into equity shares.

name: HFCL Limited
remarksWeb: # Pursuant to the terms and conditions of various sanction letters and financing documents pertaining to the Facilities availed by the Company, from time to time, certain promoters of the Company have issued Non-Disposal Undertakings (NDUs) in favour of the lenders of the Company and Security Trustee acting  for the benefits of the lenders of the Company, with respect to 24,15,48,750 equity shares, being 44.68% of the total Promoters' shareholding and 16.91% of the total paid-up equity shares capital of the Company, pursuant to which they shall not pledge or dilute or dispose-off or create any security interest or charge or encumbrance or transfer such number of shares held by them in the Company.                                               We further submit that no equity share held by any of the Promoters in the Company is pledged as on the date of filing of this Shareholding Pattern.
